name: doodle-whiteboard
description: Hand-drawn whiteboard sketchnote, stick figures, arrows, marker accents
template: A hand-drawn whiteboard doodle sketchnote of {subject}. Simple marker drawings with wobbly imperfect lines, stick figures, arrows and boxes, black marker with blue and red accents, white board background, playful and informal, uncluttered, no readable text.
negative: photo, realistic, 3d render, text, words, letters, numbers, handwriting, captions, labels, title, watermark, perfect geometry
thumb_subject: a stick figure walking along a winding path toward a small shop
notes: Models tend to write titles and labels on whiteboards (often misspelt). Describe the picture, never the words: avoid subjects such as "journey", "steps", "process" that invite captions, and add real labels in the slide tool.
